description: Check whether an independent consultant has room for another client: available billable hours, current utilization, and whether they are under target, over target, or overcommitted. Use when someone asks if they can take on new work or feels stretched. Returns a link that opens Retainer's free capacity calculator with these numbers.

committed_hours_per_week.description: Client hours per week already committed across all current engagements.

non_billable_hours_per_week.description: Weekly hours on admin, sales, and business development that nobody pays for. Default 15.

target_utilization_percent.description: Share of billable hours they want filled, leaving a buffer for overruns. Default 80.

total_hours_per_week.description: Total hours the consultant works per week. Default 45.

name: check_capacity
title: Check consulting capacity
